# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 USD | Reports to Partnerships (partner GTM) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic combines frontier-model research with an enterprise software platform centered on Claude. This position sits at the point where partner relationships must become durable customer outcomes rather than isolated introductions or
technical demonstrations.

The core challenge is scaling ecosystem delivery while preserving a consistent bar for architecture, security, adoption, and responsible AI use. Partners can expand reach dramatically, but inconsistent implementation quality can weaken
customer trust, create unnecessary escalation load, and obscure valuable product feedback.

This is fundamentally a repeatability challenge. The successful operating model will help external firms translate Claude capabilities into practical customer programs while reducing dependence on bespoke internal support.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic presents itself as an AI safety and research company focused on dependable, understandable, and controllable systems. Claude is the primary commercial vehicle through which that research reaches business users and developers.

Its enterprise model combines several motions:
- Product usage by business teams seeking support for knowledge work, analysis, and content-heavy workflows.
- Developer adoption through APIs and coding-oriented experiences.
- Enterprise deployments requiring governance, integration, security review, and organizational adoption.
- Ecosystem expansion through cloud, services, and technology organizations.

The operating imperative is to turn model differentiation into sustained production use. That requires a strong connection among product principles, customer needs, partner capability, and implementation discipline.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Enterprise AI buyers increasingly evaluate providers on more than model performance. They need credible paths from experimentation to governed use in workflows that have clear economic or operational value.

Anthropic’s emphasis on safe, accurate, and secure AI raises the importance of implementation quality. Customers and partners need practical guidance on appropriate use cases, evaluation, human oversight, data handling, and operating
guardrails, not simply access to a powerful model.

Public enterprise materials also place deployment alongside organizational change. This suggests that commercial expansion depends on helping customers build habits, processes, and internal sponsorship around AI-enabled work.

A central tension is likely to be speed versus consistency. The company needs distributed field capacity while retaining clear technical standards, realistic customer commitments, and a disciplined way to surface recurring market needs.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
The role will operate across a broad set of internal and external decision makers. Internally, the work must connect commercial urgency with product integrity and practical delivery realities.

Likely high-value internal interfaces include:
- Partnerships teams responsible for partner selection, joint planning, and commercial development.
- Sales organizations seeking stronger technical coverage on strategically important opportunities.
- Product and engineering teams that require concise, validated feedback from real deployments.
- Security, enterprise, and customer-adoption functions that shape viable customer operating patterns.

Externally, influence will extend across alliance leaders, practice owners, architects, delivery managers, customer technology sponsors, and business transformation leaders. Success depends on aligning these groups around a shared view of
value, risk, delivery ownership, and escalation paths.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Claude is positioned for complex problem solving, data analysis, writing, and software development. That breadth creates opportunity, but it also means customers need help choosing initial workflows where value, feasibility, and controls
are sufficiently clear.

Anthropic’s enterprise posture spans business users and technical builders. Effective solution guidance must therefore address both user adoption and implementation realities, including integration choices, evaluation practices, access
controls, governance expectations, and ongoing operational ownership.

The company’s focus on dependable and controllable AI is commercially meaningful. It offers a coherent lens for partner education, customer conversations, and reusable solution patterns, especially where organizations are weighing
business value against operational and reputational risk.

A mature architecture function should convert repeated field questions into validated guidance, reusable technical assets, and well-structured product insights. The objective is not to centralize every solution decision, but to raise the
quality and consistency of distributed execution.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic publicly identifies cloud, technology, and services organizations as part of its partner ecosystem. These groups serve different but complementary roles in enterprise adoption.

The ecosystem has several potential value pools:
- Cloud providers can simplify access, commercial alignment, and deployment within existing customer environments.

The strategic question is how to create leverage across these routes without making every partnership dependent on direct Anthropic intervention. That requires clear partner segmentation, practical technical readiness criteria, and
repeatable ways to identify when a partner can lead versus when deeper support is warranted.

Public material around Accenture and Anthropic points to enterprise deployment, productivity, value creation, and new-product development as relevant joint themes. This reinforces the need for concrete solution design rather than
high-level partner advocacy alone.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s public enterprise materials reflect a broadening commercial surface across enterprise administration, developer use, security, compliance, and adoption guidance. As that surface grows, partners need a coherent way to
represent the platform and deliver customer value.

The visible ecosystem spanning cloud, services, and technology participants increases the importance of partner capability development. The near-term opportunity is less about accumulating partner logos and more about building repeatable
technical competence, credible customer references, and efficient routes for issue resolution.

Competitive enterprise AI markets reward providers that help customers move quickly from evaluation to governed use. Anthropic’s positioning will be strongest when responsible-AI principles are made tangible through implementation
patterns, customer outcomes, and partner-led delivery quality.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Creating reusable implementation patterns from recurring enterprise AI deployment lessons.
- Linking rapid adoption goals to practical security, governance, evaluation, and reliability expectations.
- Helping cloud, technology, and services partners pursue customer outcomes with clear technical ownership.
- Designing escalation paths that protect strategic opportunities while strengthening partner autonomy.
- Converting field experience into high-signal product and engineering feedback.
- Prioritizing enterprise workflows where AI value can be demonstrated and sustained.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Public partner activity indicates that enterprise deployment and joint solution creation are material ecosystem themes.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims must come from the governed resume/proof graph.

Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 USD | Reports to Partnerships (partner GTM) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic combines frontier-model research with an enterprise software platform centered on Claude. This position sits at the point where partner relationships must become durable customer outcomes rather than isolated introductions or
technical demonstrations.

The core challenge is scaling ecosystem delivery while preserving a consistent bar for architecture, security, adoption, and responsible AI use. Partners can expand reach dramatically, but inconsistent implementation quality can weaken
customer trust, create unnecessary escalation load, and obscure valuable product feedback.

This is fundamentally a repeatability challenge. The successful operating model will help external firms translate Claude capabilities into practical customer programs while reducing dependence on bespoke internal support.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic presents itself as an AI safety and research company focused on dependable, understandable, and controllable systems. Claude is the primary commercial vehicle through which that research reaches business users and developers.

Its enterprise model combines several motions:
- Product usage by business teams seeking support for knowledge work, analysis, and content-heavy workflows.
- Developer adoption through APIs and coding-oriented experiences.
- Enterprise deployments requiring governance, integration, security review, and organizational adoption.
- Ecosystem expansion through cloud, services, and technology organizations.

The operating imperative is to turn model differentiation into sustained production use. That requires a strong connection among product principles, customer needs, partner capability, and implementation discipline.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Enterprise AI buyers increasingly evaluate providers on more than model performance. They need credible paths from experimentation to governed use in workflows that have clear economic or operational value.

Anthropic’s emphasis on safe, accurate, and secure AI raises the importance of implementation quality. Customers and partners need practical guidance on appropriate use cases, evaluation, human oversight, data handling, and operating
guardrails, not simply access to a powerful model.

Public enterprise materials also place deployment alongside organizational change. This suggests that commercial expansion depends on helping customers build habits, processes, and internal sponsorship around AI-enabled work.

A central tension is likely to be speed versus consistency. The company needs distributed field capacity while retaining clear technical standards, realistic customer commitments, and a disciplined way to surface recurring market needs.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
The role will operate across a broad set of internal and external decision makers. Internally, the work must connect commercial urgency with product integrity and practical delivery realities.

Likely high-value internal interfaces include:
- Partnerships teams responsible for partner selection, joint planning, and commercial development.
- Sales organizations seeking stronger technical coverage on strategically important opportunities.
- Product and engineering teams that require concise, validated feedback from real deployments.
- Security, enterprise, and customer-adoption functions that shape viable customer operating patterns.

Externally, influence will extend across alliance leaders, practice owners, architects, delivery managers, customer technology sponsors, and business transformation leaders. Success depends on aligning these groups around a shared view of
value, risk, delivery ownership, and escalation paths.

Claude is positioned for complex problem solving, data analysis, writing, and software development. That breadth creates opportunity, but it also means customers need help choosing initial workflows where value, feasibility, and controls
are sufficiently clear.

Anthropic’s enterprise posture spans business users and technical builders. Effective solution guidance must therefore address both user adoption and implementation realities, including integration choices, evaluation practices, access
controls, governance expectations, and ongoing operational ownership.

The company’s focus on dependable and controllable AI is commercially meaningful. It offers a coherent lens for partner education, customer conversations, and reusable solution patterns, especially where organizations are weighing
business value against operational and reputational risk.

A mature architecture function should convert repeated field questions into validated guidance, reusable technical assets, and well-structured product insights. The objective is not to centralize every solution decision, but to raise the
quality and consistency of distributed execution.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic publicly identifies cloud, technology, and services organizations as part of its partner ecosystem. These groups serve different but complementary roles in enterprise adoption.

The ecosystem has several potential value pools:
- Cloud providers can simplify access, commercial alignment, and deployment within existing customer environments.

The strategic question is how to create leverage across these routes without making every partnership dependent on direct Anthropic intervention. That requires clear partner segmentation, practical technical readiness criteria, and
repeatable ways to identify when a partner can lead versus when deeper support is warranted.

Public material around Accenture and Anthropic points to enterprise deployment, productivity, value creation, and new-product development as relevant joint themes. This reinforces the need for concrete solution design rather than

The visible ecosystem spanning cloud, services, and technology participants increases the importance of partner capability development. The near-term opportunity is less about accumulating partner logos and more about building repeatable
technical competence, credible customer references, and efficient routes for issue resolution.

Competitive enterprise AI markets reward providers that help customers move quickly from evaluation to governed use. Anthropic’s positioning will be strongest when responsible-AI principles are made tangible through implementation
patterns, customer outcomes, and partner-led delivery quality.

Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD
